---- MODULE W4Od17m6p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Slots  == {"c1", "c2"}
Agents == {"h1", "h2"}
NONE   == "none"
Lease  == 1
MaxT   == 2

VARIABLES owner, held, expiry, clock

vars == <<owner, held, expiry, clock>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner  \in [Slots -> Agents \cup {NONE}]
    /\ held   \in [Agents -> SUBSET Slots]
    /\ expiry \in [Slots -> 0..MaxT]
    /\ clock  \in 0..MaxT

Init ==
    /\ owner  = [s \in Slots  |-> NONE]
    /\ held   = [a \in Agents |-> {}]
    /\ expiry = [s \in Slots  |-> 0]
    /\ clock  = 0

Acquire(a, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ \A b \in Agents : s \notin held[b]
    /\ owner'  = [owner  EXCEPT ![s] = a]
    /\ held'   = [held   EXCEPT ![a] = @ \cup {s}]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Renew(a, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = a
    /\ s \in held[a]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, clock>>

Expire(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # NONE
    /\ clock >= expiry[s]
    /\ owner'  = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ held'   = [held  EXCEPT ![owner[s]] = @ \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, clock>>

AdminOverride(a, s) ==
    /\ owner'  = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = a]
    /\ held'   = [b \in Agents |-> IF b = a THEN held[b] \cup {s}
                                            ELSE held[b] \ {s}]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, expiry>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents, s \in Slots : Acquire(a, s)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, s \in Slots : Renew(a, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Expire(s)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, s \in Slots : AdminOverride(a, s)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A slot an agent believes it holds must be registered to that agent.
Coherent == \A a \in Agents, s \in Slots : (s \in held[a]) => (owner[s] = a)
====
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns bags to a small set of chutes. Each chute (slot) can be leased to a handler agent for a bounded period. A handler may acquire a free chute, taking ownership and receiving a lease that expires after a fixed duration measured on a shared clock. The handler may renew an active lease it holds to push the expiry forward. Once the clock reaches a chute's expiry the lease may expire, releasing the chute and dropping it from the handler's held set. A privileged admin override can forcibly reassign any chute to any handler at any time, stripping the chute from every other handler's held set to keep the registry and the handlers' beliefs in agreement. Time advances via a bounded tick.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No slot is ever registered to a different agent than the one that believes it holds that slot, so the same chute is never allocated to two handlers at once.

---- MODULE W4Od9m5p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes   == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Regions == {"r1", "r2"}
NONE    == "none"
Quorum  == 2

VARIABLES grant, using, votes, cand

vars == <<grant, using, votes, cand>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ grant \in Regions \cup {NONE}
    /\ using \in [Regions -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ votes \in [Nodes -> Regions \cup {NONE}]
    /\ cand  \in Regions \cup {NONE}

Init ==
    /\ grant = NONE
    /\ using = [r \in Regions |-> FALSE]
    /\ votes = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
    /\ cand  = NONE

Tally(r) == Cardinality({n \in Nodes : votes[n] = r})

Nominate(r) ==
    /\ cand = NONE
    /\ grant = NONE
    /\ cand'  = r
    /\ votes' = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, using>>

Vote(n) ==
    /\ cand # NONE
    /\ votes[n] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![n] = cand]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, using, cand>>

Grant ==
    /\ cand # NONE
    /\ Tally(cand) >= Quorum
    /\ grant' = cand
    /\ cand'  = NONE
    /\ votes' = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED using

Enter(r) ==
    /\ grant = r
    /\ ~using[r]
    /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, votes, cand>>

Exit(r) ==
    /\ using[r]
    /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ grant' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cand>>

AdminOverride(r) ==
    /\ grant' = r
    /\ using' = [x \in Regions |-> IF x = r THEN using[x] ELSE FALSE]
    /\ cand'  = NONE
    /\ votes' = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Regions : Nominate(r)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes   : Vote(n)
    \/ Grant
    \/ \E r \in Regions : Enter(r)
    \/ \E r \in Regions : Exit(r)
    \/ \E r \in Regions : AdminOverride(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A region drives the critical breaker only while it currently holds the grant.
Authorized == \A r \in Regions : using[r] => (grant = r)
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder lets regional controllers take turns driving a single critical breaker. Ownership of the breaker (the grant) is decided by quorum voting among monitoring nodes. When the breaker is free a region may nominate itself, which resets the vote tally. Each node may cast one vote for the current candidate. Once a candidate collects a quorum of votes it is granted the breaker and the votes reset. Only the region currently holding the grant may enter and drive the breaker; on exit it releases the grant. A privileged admin override can hand the grant to any region immediately, clearing every other region's active use and cancelling any in-flight vote so the registry stays consistent.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A region is ever actively driving the critical breaker only if it is the region currently holding the grant, so two regions can never operate the breaker at once.

---- MODULE W4Od13m5p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Machines == {"m1", "m2"}
Nodes    == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Cap      == 2
Quorum   == 2
Amounts  == 1..2
NONE     == "none"

VARIABLES stock, inbox, votes, prop

vars == <<stock, inbox, votes, prop>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in [Machines -> 0..Cap]
    /\ inbox \in SUBSET [node : Nodes]
    /\ votes \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ prop  \in [mac : Machines \cup {NONE}, amt : 0..2]

Init ==
    /\ stock = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ votes = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ prop  = [mac |-> NONE, amt |-> 0]

Yes == Cardinality({n \in Nodes : votes[n]})

Propose(m, k) ==
    /\ prop.mac = NONE
    /\ prop'  = [mac |-> m, amt |-> k]
    /\ votes' = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED stock

SendVote(n) ==
    /\ prop.mac # NONE
    /\ votes[n] = FALSE
    /\ ~ \E msg \in inbox : msg.node = n
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[node |-> n]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, votes, prop>>

Deliver(msg) ==
    /\ msg \in inbox
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![msg.node] = TRUE]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {msg}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, prop>>

Commit ==
    /\ prop.mac # NONE
    /\ Yes >= Quorum
    /\ stock[prop.mac] + prop.amt <= Cap
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![prop.mac] = @ + prop.amt]
    /\ prop'  = [mac |-> NONE, amt |-> 0]
    /\ votes' = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ inbox' = {}

Reject ==
    /\ prop.mac # NONE
    /\ Yes >= Quorum
    /\ stock[prop.mac] + prop.amt > Cap
    /\ prop'  = [mac |-> NONE, amt |-> 0]
    /\ votes' = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED stock

Dispense(m) ==
    /\ stock[m] > 0
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, votes, prop>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines, k \in Amounts : Propose(m, k)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : SendVote(n)
    \/ \E msg \in inbox : Deliver(msg)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Reject
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Dispense(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No machine ever holds more stock than its bounded shelf capacity.
Bounded == \A m \in Machines : stock[m] <= Cap
====
nl:
A network of vending machines coordinates restocks through quorum voting. When no restock is in flight, an operator proposes adding a batch of a chosen size to one machine, which resets the vote tally and clears the message bus. Monitoring nodes each emit a single approval message onto a shared bus; because the bus is asynchronous these messages can be delivered and processed in any order. Delivering a message records that node's vote. Once a quorum of votes has been recorded, the restock commits only if the machine's current stock plus the batch stays within capacity; if a quorum approves but the batch would overflow, the proposal is instead rejected and discarded. Independently, any machine may dispense one item, lowering its stock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No machine's stock ever exceeds its fixed shelf capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od10m0p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Blocks == {"b1", "b2"}
Trains == {"t1", "t2"}
NONE   == "none"
MaxV   == 3

VARIABLES occ, ver, loc, snap, crashed

vars == <<occ, ver, loc, snap, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ occ     \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {NONE}]
    /\ ver     \in [Blocks -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ loc     \in [Trains -> Blocks \cup {NONE}]
    /\ snap    \in [Trains -> [blk : Blocks \cup {NONE}, v : 0..MaxV]]
    /\ crashed \in [Trains -> BOOLEAN]

NoSnap == [blk |-> NONE, v |-> 0]

Init ==
    /\ occ     = [b \in Blocks |-> NONE]
    /\ ver     = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ loc     = [t \in Trains |-> NONE]
    /\ snap    = [t \in Trains |-> NoSnap]
    /\ crashed = [t \in Trains |-> FALSE]

Read(t, b) ==
    /\ ~crashed[t]
    /\ loc[t] = NONE
    /\ snap[t].blk = NONE
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = [blk |-> b, v |-> ver[b]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver, loc, crashed>>

Enter(t) ==
    /\ ~crashed[t]
    /\ snap[t].blk # NONE
    /\ LET b == snap[t].blk IN
        /\ ver[b] = snap[t].v
        /\ occ[b] = NONE
        /\ ver[b] < MaxV
        /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = t]
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
        /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = b]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Retry(t) ==
    /\ ~crashed[t]
    /\ snap[t].blk # NONE
    /\ ver[snap[t].blk] # snap[t].v
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver, loc, crashed>>

Leave(t) ==
    /\ ~crashed[t]
    /\ loc[t] # NONE
    /\ ver[loc[t]] < MaxV
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![loc[t]] = NONE]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![loc[t]] = @ + 1]
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, crashed>>

Crash(t) ==
    /\ ~crashed[t]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver, loc, snap>>

Restart(t) ==
    /\ crashed[t]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver, loc, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Read(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Enter(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Retry(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Leave(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Crash(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Restart(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A train's own record of the block it occupies agrees exactly with the
\* block registry, so no two trains ever occupy the same signalling block.
Coherent == \A t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : (loc[t] = b) <=> (occ[b] = t)
====
nl:
A subway signalling system grants trains exclusive occupancy of track blocks using optimistic locking. To enter a block a train first reads a snapshot of that block's version counter. It then attempts to commit its entry: the entry succeeds only if the block's version is still what it read and the block is free, at which point the train records its location, the registry records the occupant, and the version counter bumps. If the version changed since the read, the train abandons the snapshot and retries. A train leaving its block clears both its own location and the registry and bumps the version again. Any train may crash silently at any time; a crashed train takes no further actions but leaves the registry as it was until it is restarted, after which it may resume reading and entering blocks.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each train's recorded location and the block occupancy registry always agree, so two trains can never occupy the same block simultaneously.

---- MODULE W4Od5m5p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Players == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
Auth    == {"p1", "p2"}          \* p3 is an unauthorized spectator
Quorum  == 2
MaxGen  == 3
NONE    == "none"

VARIABLES gen, prop, votes, pending, crashed

vars == <<gen, prop, votes, pending, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ gen     \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ prop    \in [who : Players \cup {NONE}, g : 0..MaxGen]
    /\ votes   \in [Players -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ pending \in [who : Players \cup {NONE}, g : 0..MaxGen]
    /\ crashed \in [Players -> BOOLEAN]

NoProp == [who |-> NONE, g |-> 0]

Init ==
    /\ gen     = 0
    /\ prop    = NoProp
    /\ votes   = [p \in Players |-> FALSE]
    /\ pending = NoProp
    /\ crashed = [p \in Players |-> FALSE]

Yes == Cardinality({p \in Players : votes[p]})

Propose(p) ==
    /\ ~crashed[p]
    /\ prop.who = NONE
    /\ prop'  = [who |-> p, g |-> gen]
    /\ votes' = [q \in Players |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, pending, crashed>>

Vote(v) ==
    /\ ~crashed[v]
    /\ prop.who # NONE
    /\ votes[v] = FALSE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![v] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, prop, pending, crashed>>

Commit ==
    /\ prop.who # NONE
    /\ pending.who = NONE
    /\ Yes >= Quorum
    /\ prop.who \in Auth
    /\ prop.g = gen
    /\ pending' = [who |-> prop.who, g |-> prop.g]
    /\ prop'    = NoProp
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, votes, crashed>>

Discard ==
    /\ prop.who # NONE
    /\ Yes >= Quorum
    /\ ~(prop.who \in Auth /\ prop.g = gen)
    /\ prop' = NoProp
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, votes, pending, crashed>>

Ack ==
    /\ pending.who # NONE
    /\ pending' = NoProp
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, prop, votes, crashed>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ pending.who = NONE
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen'   = gen + 1
    /\ prop'  = NoProp
    /\ votes' = [p \in Players |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ ~crashed[p]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, prop, votes, pending>>

Restart(p) ==
    /\ crashed[p]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, prop, votes, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Propose(p)
    \/ \E v \in Players : Vote(v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Discard
    \/ Ack
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E p \in Players : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Restart(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Any action awaiting acknowledgement was committed by a currently-authorized
\* player at the current lobby generation (never an unauthorized or stale one).
Valid == pending.who # NONE => (pending.who \in Auth /\ pending.g = gen)
====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker gates every privileged game action behind a quorum vote. Only some players are authorized members; others are unauthorized spectators. Any player may propose an action, which resets the vote tally; players may each cast one approval vote. Once a quorum approves and no action is awaiting acknowledgement, the action commits into a pending slot, but only if the proposer is an authorized member and the proposal was made at the current lobby generation; a quorum-approved proposal that is unauthorized or stale is instead discarded. The committed pending action is later acknowledged, freeing the slot. The lobby may reconfigure, bumping its generation and cancelling in-flight votes, but only while no action is pending. Any player may crash silently and later be restarted, taking no actions while crashed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any action waiting to be acknowledged was committed by a player who is authorized and whose proposal matched the current lobby generation, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever acts.

---- MODULE W4Od5m7p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Players == {"p1", "p2"}
N       == 2          \* total seat tokens, conserved
MaxV    == 3
MaxCap  == 2

VARIABLES pool, held, ver, cap, snap

vars == <<pool, held, ver, cap, snap>>

Ops == {"idle", "claim", "release"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in 0..N
    /\ held \in [Players -> 0..N]
    /\ ver  \in 0..MaxV
    /\ cap  \in [Players -> 0..MaxCap]
    /\ snap \in [Players -> [ver : 0..MaxV, want : Ops]]

Init ==
    /\ pool = N
    /\ held = [p \in Players |-> 0]
    /\ ver  = 0
    /\ cap  = [p \in Players |-> MaxCap]
    /\ snap = [p \in Players |-> [ver |-> 0, want |-> "idle"]]

Read(p, op) ==
    /\ op \in {"claim", "release"}
    /\ snap[p].want = "idle"
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = [ver |-> ver, want |-> op]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, ver, cap>>

CommitClaim(p) ==
    /\ snap[p].want = "claim"
    /\ snap[p].ver = ver
    /\ ver < MaxV
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ held[p] < cap[p]
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = @ + 1]
    /\ ver'  = ver + 1
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = [ver |-> 0, want |-> "idle"]]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

CommitRelease(p) ==
    /\ snap[p].want = "release"
    /\ snap[p].ver = ver
    /\ ver < MaxV
    /\ held[p] > 0
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
    /\ ver'  = ver + 1
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = [ver |-> 0, want |-> "idle"]]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Abort(p) ==
    /\ snap[p].want # "idle"
    /\ snap[p].ver # ver
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = [ver |-> 0, want |-> "idle"]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, ver, cap>>

ChangeCap(p, c) ==
    /\ c \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![p] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, ver, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, op \in {"claim","release"} : Read(p, op)
    \/ \E p \in Players : CommitClaim(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : CommitRelease(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Abort(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players, c \in 0..MaxCap : ChangeCap(p, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Seat tokens are neither created nor destroyed: the free pool plus every
\* player's held seats always sums to the fixed total.
Conserved == pool + held["p1"] + held["p2"] = N
====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker hands out a fixed set of seat tokens through a versioned compare-and-swap register. A player wanting to claim or release a seat first reads a snapshot of the register's version. It then attempts to commit the operation: a claim succeeds only if the snapshot version still matches, the free pool has a token, and the player is below its current per-player capacity, moving one token from the pool to the player and bumping the version; a release symmetrically returns a token to the pool. If the version has moved since the read, the compare-and-swap fails and the operation is aborted for retry. Each player's seat capacity can change at runtime, which constrains future claims but never moves any tokens.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The free pool plus all players' held seats always equals the fixed total number of seat tokens, so seats are never created or destroyed.

---- MODULE W4Od17m2p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Reqs   == {"r1", "r2"}
Slots  == {"s1", "s2"}
Cohort == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE   == "none"
Votes  == {"none", "yes", "no"}
Phases == {"idle", "prepare", "committed", "aborted"}

VARIABLES asg, phase, cur, votes, slow

vars == <<asg, phase, cur, votes, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ asg   \in [Reqs -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ cur   \in [req : Reqs \cup {NONE}, slot : Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ votes \in [Cohort -> Votes]
    /\ slow  \in [Cohort -> BOOLEAN]

NoCur == [req |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]

Init ==
    /\ asg   = [r \in Reqs |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ cur   = NoCur
    /\ votes = [c \in Cohort |-> "none"]
    /\ slow  = [c \in Cohort |-> FALSE]

Begin(r, s) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ asg[r] = NONE
    /\ \A rr \in Reqs : asg[rr] # s
    /\ cur'   = [req |-> r, slot |-> s]
    /\ phase' = "prepare"
    /\ votes' = [c \in Cohort |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<asg, slow>>

Stall(c) ==
    /\ ~slow[c]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<asg, phase, cur, votes>>

Resume(c) ==
    /\ slow[c]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<asg, phase, cur, votes>>

Vote(c, v) ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ ~slow[c]
    /\ votes[c] = "none"
    /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<asg, phase, cur, slow>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ \A c \in Cohort : votes[c] = "yes"
    /\ \A rr \in Reqs : asg[rr] # cur.slot
    /\ asg'   = [asg EXCEPT ![cur.req] = cur.slot]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cur, votes, slow>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ \E c \in Cohort : votes[c] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<asg, cur, votes, slow>>

Done ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ cur'   = NoCur
    /\ votes' = [c \in Cohort |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<asg, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Reqs, s \in Slots : Begin(r, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cohort : Stall(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cohort : Resume(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cohort, v \in {"yes","no"} : Vote(c, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Done

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Two distinct requests are never both allocated the same baggage slot.
NoDouble ==
    \A r1, r2 \in Reqs :
        (r1 # r2 /\ asg[r1] # NONE /\ asg[r2] # NONE) => asg[r1] # asg[r2]
====
nl:
An airport baggage router allocates chute slots to bag requests using two-phase commit across resource-manager participants. When idle, the coordinator begins a transaction for an unassigned request and a currently-free slot, moving to the prepare phase and resetting votes. Each participant votes yes or no. A participant may be slow: it can stall, refusing to vote until it resumes, but it never fails and always eventually resumes. Only when every participant has voted yes and the target slot is still free does the transaction commit, recording the allocation; if any participant votes no the transaction aborts. After a commit or abort the coordinator returns to idle, clearing the current transaction and votes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two distinct bag requests are ever allocated the same chute slot.

---- MODULE W4Od10m5p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Quorum == 2
N      == 3          \* total trains, conserved
Dirs   == {"none", "dispatch", "recall"}

VARIABLES depot, online, prop, votes, slow

vars == <<depot, online, prop, votes, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ depot  \in 0..N
    /\ online \in 0..N
    /\ prop   \in Dirs
    /\ votes  \in [Voters -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ slow   \in [Voters -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ depot  = N
    /\ online = 0
    /\ prop   = "none"
    /\ votes  = [v \in Voters |-> FALSE]

Any pharmacist may crash silently and later restart, taking no actions while crashed.

    /\ accepted = {}

    /\ [stu |-> s, term |-> k] \notin queue

    /\ m.stu \in Authorized
    /\ m.term = term
    /\ accepted' = accepted \cup {m}
    /\ queue'    = queue \ {m}

    /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<accepted, term, enrolled, open>>

\* was stamped with the current term, never an unauthorized or stale request.

A university course-registration system processes enrollment requests through a bounded work queue with backpressure. While the registration window is open, any student may enqueue an enrollment request stamped with a term number no later than the current term; the enqueue is refused (backpressure) when the queue is already at capacity. Because the queue is asynchronous, the worker may process or reject the requests it holds in any order. An accepted request is later acknowledged, adding that student to the finalized enrolled set. The registration window may be toggled open or closed at any time. The term may advance only once the accepted set has fully drained, which resets the enrolled set for the new term.

EXTENDS Integers

Carts  == {"a1", "a2"}
NONE   == "none"
MaxV   == 3

VARIABLES occ, ver, busy, rd

vars == <<occ, ver, busy, rd>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ occ  \in [Chutes -> Carts \cup {NONE}]
    /\ ver  \in [Chutes -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ busy \in [Carts -> Chutes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ rd   \in [Carts -> [chute : Chutes \cup {NONE}, v : 0..MaxV]]

NoRd == [chute |-> NONE, v |-> 0]

Init ==
    /\ occ  = [c \in Chutes |-> NONE]
    /\ ver  = [c \in Chutes |-> 0]
    /\ busy = [a \in Carts |-> NONE]
    /\ rd   = [a \in Carts |-> NoRd]

Read(a, c) ==
    /\ rd[a].chute = NONE
    /\ busy[a] = NONE
    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![a] = [chute |-> c, v |-> ver[c]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver, busy>>

Acquire(a) ==
    /\ rd[a].chute # NONE
    /\ LET c == rd[a].chute IN
        /\ occ[c] = NONE
        /\ ver[c] = rd[a].v
        /\ ver[c] < MaxV
        /\ occ'  = [occ EXCEPT ![c] = a]
        /\ ver'  = [ver EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
        /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![a] = c]
    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![a] = NoRd]

Retry(a) ==
    /\ rd[a].chute # NONE
    /\ ver[rd[a].chute] # rd[a].v
    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![a] = NoRd]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, ver, busy>>

Release(a) ==
    /\ busy[a] # NONE
    /\ ver[busy[a]] < MaxV
    /\ occ'  = [occ EXCEPT ![busy[a]] = NONE]
    /\ ver'  = [ver EXCEPT ![busy[a]] = @ + 1]
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![a] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED rd

AdminOverride(a, c) ==
    /\ occ'  = [x \in Chutes |-> IF x = c THEN a
                                 ELSE IF occ[x] = a THEN NONE ELSE occ[x]]
    /\ busy' = [b \in Carts  |-> IF b = a THEN c
                                 ELSE IF busy[b] = c THEN NONE ELSE busy[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rd>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Carts, c \in Chutes : Read(a, c)
    \/ \E a \in Carts : Acquire(a)
    \/ \E a \in Carts : Retry(a)
    \/ \E a \in Carts : Release(a)
    \/ \E a \in Carts, c \in Chutes : AdminOverride(a, c)

\* A cart is recorded as busy on a chute only if that chute's registry lists
\* the cart as its occupant, so two carts never service the same chute.
MutEx == \A a \in Carts, c \in Chutes : (busy[a] = c) => (occ[c] = a)
====
nl:
An airport baggage router gives carts exclusive access to chutes using optimistic locking with retry. To take a chute, a cart first reads a snapshot of that chute's version counter. It then attempts to acquire: the acquisition succeeds only if the chute is free and its version still matches the snapshot, at which point the registry records the cart as occupant, the cart marks itself busy on that chute, and the version bumps.     /\ ~crashed[r]
    /\ bay = r
    /\ ~using[r]
    /\ queue > 0
    /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ queue' = queue - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bay, crashed>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ ~crashed[r]
    /\ using[r]
    /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ bay'   = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed>>

Abort(r) ==
    /\ ~crashed[r]
    /\ bay = r
    /\ ~using[r]
    /\ bay' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, using, crashed>>

Crash(r) ==
    /\ ~crashed[r]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, bay, using>>

Restart(r) ==
    /\ crashed[r]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, bay, using>>

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Acquire(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Process(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Release(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Abort(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Crash(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Restart(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A robot is servicing a task in the charging bay only while it holds the
\* single bay, so two robots are never in the critical bay at once.
MutEx == \A r \in Robots : using[r] => (bay = r)
====
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet pulls work from a bounded task queue with backpressure and executes each task inside a single shared charging bay that offers mutual exclusion. New tasks may be enqueued while the queue is below capacity; once full, further enqueues are refused (backpressure). A non-crashed robot may acquire the free bay. Holding the bay, a robot may process one queued task, consuming it from the queue and marking itself as servicing. It then releases the bay when done. A robot that holds the bay without having started servicing may instead abort, freeing the bay. Any robot may crash silently and later restart, taking no bay actions while crashed; a crashed robot keeps whatever bay it held until it restarts.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A robot is servicing a task in the charging bay only while it holds the single bay, so two robots can never occupy the critical bay simultaneously.

---- MODULE W4Od7m9p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Stacks  == {"s1", "s2"}
CMax    == 3
MaxMove == 2
MaxEp   == 2

VARIABLES height, cap, moving, epoch

vars == <<height, cap, moving, epoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ height \in [Stacks -> 0..CMax]
    /\ cap    \in 0..CMax
    /\ moving \in 0..MaxMove
    /\ epoch  \in 0..MaxEp

Init ==
    /\ height = [s \in Stacks |-> 0]
    /\ cap    = CMax
    /\ moving = 0
    /\ epoch  = 0

Load(s) ==
    /\ height[s] < cap
    /\ height' = [height EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, moving, epoch>>

Unload(s) ==
    /\ height[s] > 0
    /\ height' = [height EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, moving, epoch>>

Lift(s) ==
    /\ height[s] > 0
    /\ moving < MaxMove
    /\ height' = [height EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
    /\ moving' = moving + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, epoch>>

Place(s) ==
    /\ moving > 0
    /\ height[s] < cap
    /\ height' = [height EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ moving' = moving - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, epoch>>

ChangeCap(c) ==
    /\ c \in 0..CMax
    /\ \A s \in Stacks : height[s] <= c
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<height, moving, epoch>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEp
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<height, cap, moving>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Stacks : Load(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stacks : Unload(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stacks : Lift(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stacks : Place(s)
    \/ \E c \in 0..CMax : ChangeCap(c)
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No stack's height ever exceeds the current yard capacity.
Bounded == \A s \in Stacks : height[s] <= cap
====
nl:
A container-ship crane yard stacks containers under epoch-numbered reconfiguration. A container may be loaded onto a stack while that stack is below the current capacity. A container may be unloaded from a non-empty stack. A crane may lift a container off a non-empty stack into transit, provided the number of containers already in transit is below the crane limit, and may later place a container from transit onto a stack that is below capacity. The yard capacity can change at runtime, but a new capacity is only accepted if no existing stack already exceeds it. An epoch-numbered reconfiguration bumps the epoch to begin a fresh planning round without moving any container.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No stack's height ever exceeds the current yard capacity.
